newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Quantum raises El-Rov stake to 5.44 pct.
newsitem.headline: Quantum raises El-Rov stake to 5.44 pct.

text.p: Quantum Emerging Growth Partners CV, a fund controlled by U.S. investor George Soros, has increased its holding in El-Rov (Israel) Ltd to 5.44 percent, El Rov said on Tuesday.

Quantum is now considered a major shareholder in the company under Israeli securities regulations, but a spokesman for the company said that as far as management knew the holding was only a financial investment.
El-Rov, a property developer, said Quantum had acquired 75,816 shares in the company at 15.057 shekels each on December 11, increasing its stake to 679,760 shares, or 5.44 percent of equity.
At El-Rov's current market capitalisation, Quantum's holding is worth about $3.1 million.
El-Rov is 72 percent-controlled by Alfred Akirov and controls two other companies traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange -- El-Kanit Development Ltd and Adasha Development Ltd.
